import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, flow, capacity;
        Edge(int t, int r, int f, int c) {
            to = t;
            rev = r;
            flow = f;
            capacity = c;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] graph = new List[MAXN];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] current_ptr = new int[MAXN];
    static int source, sink;

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int rcap) {
        graph[u].add(new Edge(v, graph[v].size(), 0, cap));
        graph[v].add(new Edge(u, graph[u].size() - 1, 0, rcap));
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty() && dist[sink] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                int v = e.to;
                if (dist[v] == -1 && e.flow < e.capacity) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flow_limit) {
        if (u == sink || flow_limit == 0) return flow_limit;
        for (; current_ptr[u] < graph[u].size(); ++current_ptr[u]) {
            Edge e = graph[u].get(current_ptr[u]);
            int v = e.to;
            if (dist[v] != dist[u] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(v, Math.min(flow_limit, e.capacity - e.flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.flow += pushed;
                graph[v].get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(current_ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(source, INF)) > 0) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static int rows, max_dist;
    static int[][] blocked, time_limit, distances;
    static String[] original, required;

    static void bfs_grid(int start_r, int start_c, int[][] dist_grid, boolean use_time_limit) {
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(dist_grid[i], -1);
        dist_grid[start_r][start_c] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{start_r, start_c});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            if (use_time_limit && dist_grid[r][c] == time_limit[r][c]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nr = r + dx[d], nc = c + dy[d];
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= rows || nc < 0 || nc >= rows || dist_grid[nr][nc] != -1 || blocked[nr][nc] != 0) continue;
                if (use_time_limit && time_limit[nr][nc] > -1 && dist_grid[r][c] + 1 > time_limit[nr][nc]) continue;
                dist_grid[nr][nc] = dist_grid[r][c] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        rows = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        max_dist = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        original = new String[rows];
        required = new String[rows];
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) original[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) required[i] = br.readLine();
        
        blocked = new int[rows][rows];
        time_limit = new int[rows][rows];
        distances = new int[rows][rows];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; ++j)
                blocked[i][j] = (original[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') ? 1 : 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; ++j)
                if (original[i].charAt(j) == 'Z')
                    bfs_grid(i, j, time_limit, false);
        
        source = 2 * rows * rows + 5;
        sink = source + 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i)
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int x = 0; x < rows; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < rows; ++y) {
                if (original[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' || original[x].charAt(y) == 'Y') continue;
                add_edge(source, rows * x + y, original[x].charAt(y) - '0', 0);
                add_edge(rows * rows + rows * x + y, sink, required[x].charAt(y) - '0', 0);
                bfs_grid(x, y, distances, true);
                for (int xp = 0; xp < rows; ++xp) {
                    for (int yp = 0; yp < rows; ++yp) {
                        if (distances[xp][yp] != -1 && distances[xp][yp] <= max_dist) {
                            add_edge(rows * x + y, rows * rows + rows * xp + yp, INF, 0);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
